name: Phantom Mansion II: Treasures of the Seven Seas - The Arabian Sea
summary: Ahoy, matey! Hector is still trolling the Seven Seas! Hector awakens to find the shore is sand as far as can be seen. He has arrived in the Arabian Sea. Hector searches for treasure in a pyramidal structure. Using the arrow keys, you must guide Hector from room to room, solving the puzzles in each room to get the golden treasure skulls. Avoid ghosts and other nasty creatures. Avoid stepping into water or you be going to Davey Jones' Locker. If you encounter a locked door, somewhere within the room will be a matching key. Switches can also be used to open walls.
